title: Differential Synchronization
summary: Neil Fraser of Google presents Differential Synchronization, the algorithm behind MobWrite, for keeping multiple copies of a document in sync in real time. The talk argues the approach is robust, convergent and efficient.
why: HN points to it as a simple diff-and-patch alternative to operational transforms and CRDTs for collaborative editing.

quote.text: The really nice bits, though, are that it is a simple algorithm
